data.one_liner: Jalali, Gregorian, and time pickers with Cupertino style and responsive UI.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable date and time picker widgets and dialogs supporting both Jalali (Persian/Shamsi) and Gregorian calendars. Features a Cupertino-style interface with a responsive layout for mobile, web, and desktop applications.
use_when: You need to support Jalali (Persian) calendar date picking in your Flutter app.
You want Cupertino-style date and time pickers with a responsive UI across platforms.
avoid_when: You only need standard Material date pickers without Persian calendar support.
You require complex form validation frameworks rather than standalone pickers.
strengths: Supports both Jalali and Gregorian calendars alongside a dedicated time picker.
Cupertino-style design with responsive UI across Android, iOS, Web, and desktop platforms.
weaknesses: Limited localization and customization options outside of what is explicitly exposed.
Relies on specific third-party date libraries like shamsi_date.

alternatives.name: calendar_date_picker2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need a customizable Material Design calendar date picker instead of Cupertino-style pickers.
